topic: Dark Fleet Tankers & Satellite AIS Spoofing
youtubeDescription:
Uncover the shadowy world of 'Dark Fleet' oil tankers manipulating satellite signals to disappear from global maps. Learn how these ghost ships transport billions in illicit cargo, leaving a trail of fake GPS data.

cuts.voiceoverText: Ghost oil tankers vanish from maps, carrying billions in illicit cargo. This isn't fiction; it's the 'Dark Fleet'.
These ships manipulate satellite AIS signals, faking GPS coordinates. They create phantom circular orbit routes.
Transporting $50 billion in illicit oil, they bypass sanctions and evade global oversight.
Fake circular tracks confuse algorithms, designed to spot direct routes, making detection incredibly complex.
This shadow economy undermines international law, fueling conflicts, and posing immense environmental risks globally.
With each manipulated signal, vast fortunes vanish into the maritime abyss, leaving everyone still asking...
